parameters.name: Stall Prevention Selection during Acceleration
parameters.description: Selects the Stall Prevention method used to prevent excessive current during acceleration.

options.label: Disabled - Motor accelerates at active acceleration rate. The motor may stall if load is too heavy or accel time is too short.
General Purpose - When output current exceeds L3-02 level, acceleration stops. Acceleration will continue when the output current level falls below the L3-02 level.
Intelligent - The active acceleration rate is ignored. Acceleration is completed in the shortest amount of time without exceeding the current value set in L3-02.

modbus_registers.name: Supported function codes
modbus_registers.description: Three function codes. A drive MEMOBUS/Modbus register always has a data length of two bytes. Function code 03H reads a maximum of 16 registers at a time (p.437). Error code 01H: function code other than 03H, 08H, and 10H (p.451).
modbus_registers.evidence_quote: 03H Read MEMOBUS/Modbus registers 8 8 7 37 08H Loopback test 8 8 8 8 10H Write to multiple MEMOBUS/Modbus registers 11 41 8 8

modbus_registers.name: Operation Signals and Multi-function Inputs

bit_definitions.meaning: H5-12 = 0: Forward Run Command (0 = Stop, 1 = Forward Run); H5-12 = 1: Run Command (0 = Stop, 1 = Run)
H5-12 = 0: Reverse Run Command (0 = Stop, 1 = Reverse Run); H5-12 = 1: Forward/Reverse (0 = Forward, 1 = Reverse)
Multi-Function Input 1 (Function is ComRef when H1-01 = 40 (Forward/Stop))
Multi-Function Input 2 (Function is ComCtrl when H1-02 = 41 (Reverse/Stop))

modbus_registers.description: Command data (it is possible to both read and write command data). Bits that are not used should be set to 0. Function codes listed are the drive read/write codes (03H, 10H); no per-register code is printed.
modbus_registers.evidence_quote: 0001H Operation Signals and Multi-function Inputs bit 0 H5-12 = 0: Forward Run Command (0 = Stop, 1 = Forward Run) H5-12 = 1: Run Command (0 = Stop, 1 = Run) bit 1 H5-12 = 0: Reverse Run Command (0 = Stop, 1 = Reverse Run) H5-12 = 1: Forward/Reverse (0 = Forward, 1 = Reverse) bit 2 External Fault (EF0) bit 3 Fault Reset

modbus_registers.scaling: <2> 0.01 A units for drives set to 11 kW in Heavy or Normal Duty and 0.1 A units for drives set to 15 kW and above.
modbus_registers.description: Monitor data (read only). Footnote <2> text from p.447.

modbus_registers.name: Enter Command (EEPROM / RAM)
modbus_registers.description: An Enter command is enabled by writing 0 to register number 0900H or 0910H. 0900H writes data into the EEPROM and enables the data in RAM; 0910H writes data in the RAM only. These registers are write-only. Whether Enter is required depends on H5-11. Function code 10H is assumed from the write example on p.438 (not printed for 0900H itself).
modbus_registers.evidence_quote: An Enter command is enabled by writing 0 to register number 0900H or 0910H. These registers can be written to only. An error will occur if the user attempts to read from these registers.

notes: Source: the "heavy" file (498 pages, YASKAWA AC Drive - V1000 Technical Manual, SIEP C710606 18C) per coordinator instruction. The "light" file is a different document: V1000 Quick Start Guide, MANUAL NO. TOEP C710606 15C (YASKAWA Europe, 44 pages); it was not used for extraction.
PDF page index equals the printed page number throughout this manual (e.g. PDF page 349 shows "349").
Page 1 (cover) has no text layer; model_evidence uses the page-2 footer.

Evidence quotes were checked by script against the pdf.js text layer of each cited page (whitespace-normalized). Some range/default values that sit in merged table cells (C1-02..C1-04, d1-02, d1-17, E1-04) are not inside the quoted span; they were read from rendered page images and the note on each record says so.

Footnote markers (<1>, <2>, ...) are defined per parameter group and their meaning differs between groups; meanings were taken from the footnote list of the same group (A/b/C/d: e.g. C and d groups <1> = "Parameter can be changed during run"; E group <1> = "Values shown here are for 200 V class drives. Double the value when using a 400 V class drive.").
Voltage values (E1-05, T1-03) are 200 V class values; the manual says to double them for 400 V class drives.
Rated motor voltage, base frequency (motor) and rated speed exist only as Auto-Tuning inputs (T1-03, T1-05, T1-07); E1-06 is the V/f base frequency.

No documented general rule mapping parameter numbers to MEMOBUS/Modbus registers was found in Appendix C. The B.2 Parameter Table has an "Addr. Hex" column per parameter (e.g. b1-01 = 180, H5-01 = 425), but the table does not state in words that this is the MEMOBUS/Modbus register number; no record was created for it.

Not extracted: comm protocol selection (only MEMOBUS/Modbus RTU on the built-in port, p.426: "Protocol MEMOBUS/Modbus (using RTU mode only)", "Max Number of Slaves 31 drives"), H1/H2 option lists (pp. 369-373), L3-05 details.
H5-01 range "0 to 20 H" and default "1F" are hexadecimal as printed.
0002H broadcast frequency reference is printed as "30000/100%" (p.448), while command register 0002H units are "determined by parameter o1-03" (p.439).
